name: Revoke a runner
description: Admin only. Stops ONE MACHINE without touching the credential it was started from -- the difference between 'that Mac Mini is misbehaving' and 'that key is compromised'. Any admin may revoke any runner, because the fleet is the deployment's and a wedged machine is not its owner's private business. The runner's next call fails at the live_runners JOIN inside each statement; rows it is holding lapse and requeue, which is the same recovery a power cut gets. It can come back: the token exchange upserts on (key_id, label), so revoking is not a delete and a returning machine is the same row.
